content.title: Adyen sets new targets, outpacing European rivals
content.summary: (Reuters) -Adyen, the Dutch company known for handling payment processing for eBay and Spotify, set ​new financial targets on Tuesday, aiming for stronger profitability and steady ‌revenue growth.  The company is gaining ground against U.S. rivals despite most European peers struggling,‌ helped by its strategy of expanding in North America and Asia.  Following 2026, annual revenue growth is expected to come ‍in at around 20% "in any given year," Adyen said, adding that it will refine its outlook each February.
